ModMetaData.name: RimMT Diagnostics v0.20.6 - Safe Top-Level Tails
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Low-overhead top-level tail diagnostics for RimMT. Measures complete ticks plus aggregate MapPostTick, WorldTick and StorytellerTick. It does not patch Pawn, WorkGiver, GenClosest, Reachability, PathFinder or individual MapComponent overrides, avoiding the MoreFactionInteraction initialization regression. On-demand reports include RimMT production counters and Harmony ownership.
